terminalMessage: Pipe the value in instead of typing it, for example: pbpaste | <command> --stdin. Typing secrets into the terminal is off to keep them out of your scrollback.

files-changed.message: {product}'s private files changed while it was reading them.

files-unavailable.message: {product} couldn't read or save its private files.

helper-unavailable.message: {product}'s file helper is missing or didn't respond.

input-too-large.message: The value is larger than {product} accepts.
input-too-large.next: Check that you copied only the value, then try again.

service-timeout.message: {product}'s background service didn't answer in time.

service-unexpected.message: {product}'s background service sent an answer {product} didn't expect.

terminal-input.message: {product} reads this value from a pipe, not from typing, so it stays out of your terminal history.

unexpected.message: {product} hit an unexpected problem with its private files.

unsafe-permissions.message: {product} stopped because its private files can be read by other users or aren't owned by you.
